title: dropout and jagged waveform recovery benchmark

pre_registered.reproduction: exact S00 selected B-stave pulse count from raw h101/HRDv ROOT
pre_registered.metric: run-heldout MAE of recovered CFD20 timing error after injected dropout or jagged sample corruption; sigma68_ns is reported as a secondary robust-width diagnostic
pre_registered.win_rule: lowest heldout MAE among recovery methods; require the same heldout runs and paired run-block bootstrap CIs for all methods

next_tickets.title: P06g: Real-waveform dropout candidate transfer of injected recovery frontier
next_tickets.body: Apply the P06 injected-dropout recovery frontier to naturally occurring dropout/jagged candidates, matched by run, stave, amplitude, peak phase, and anomaly taxon. Expected information gain: separates recovery methods that only repair synthetic masks from methods that transfer to real electronics pathologies.
